title: Men We Reaped: A Memoir
author: Jesmyn Ward
summary: Jesmyn Ward writes about five young Black men in her Mississippi community, including her brother, who died within four years. She alternates their stories with her own childhood and family history.
readIf: you want a powerful, personal book about grief, poverty and race in the rural South.
skipIf: you are not ready for sustained sadness and loss.
